{{Quote|&hellip;Dana Cory...|General Mohc calls Dana Cory to receive an award|<ref name="SftE" />}}
'''Dana Cory''' was a soldier in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who trained as a [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|of Carida]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Cory joined the academy<ref name="SftE" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="Reader Date 1">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', and by extension the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]], at a date of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The text mentions that the cadets graduating have spent four years at the academy. Using simple math, it can be deduced that Dana Cory joined the academy at a date of [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].</ref> and graduated<ref name="SftE" /> during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Reader Date 2">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', and by extension the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]], at a date of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> Cory's ceremony was presided over by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]]. After Mohc delivered a speech to the cadets, [[Gender/Legends|he]] called the names of cadets who were to be given an award of valor and merit, Cory included.<ref name="SftE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dana Cory was first mentioned in the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]] of the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', which was released in [[1997]]. As the character's name is only given in spoken dialogue from the audio adaption, the actual spelling of the character's name cannot be determined.
